entries.label: Enable hunger
entries.help: Toggles passive hunger drain and hunger depletion penalties.

entries.label: Enable thirst
entries.help: Toggles passive thirst drain, thirst depletion penalties, and periodic dehydration damage.

entries.label: Hunger drain
entries.help: Scales all passive hunger drain rules.

entries.label: Thirst drain
entries.help: Scales all passive thirst drain rules.

entries.label: Show hunger bar
entries.help: Draw the orange hunger bar in the fixed magic-bar stack.

entries.label: Show thirst bar
entries.help: Draw the blue thirst bar in the fixed magic-bar stack.

entries.label: HUD scale
entries.help: Applies to the hunger and thirst fixed bars.

entries.label: HUD opacity
entries.help: Controls the shared alpha used by the hunger and thirst bars.
